title: Chapter 100
text: Fliers and riders are held equal in every regard with the exception of wing structure. Riders will maintain their wings, sections, and squads, as well as retain their commands. Every drift will be absorbed by a squad, and their leader will replace the squad’s current executive officer for unit cohesiveness and efficiency. —A RTICLE T WO , S ECTION O NE T HE A RETIA A CCORD
